title: OpenTelemetry connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One OTLP receiver instance's settings: which signals are accepted, how they are named on the Fabric, and how a request authenticates. The receivers are on ingest's loopback listener under /v1/namespaces/{ns}/fabric/otlp/{instance}/… (D111, §33 §2.2's remote-ingress note), so the path is derived from the instance and is not configured here. `auth.bearer_token` and `tls.key_pem` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list.

signals.description: Which OTLP signals this instance accepts; one CloudEvent per log record, span or data point (CN1 Task 13's otlp_http_and_grpc_each_signal).

transports.description: Which transports are bound. OTLP/HTTP takes protobuf and JSON on /v1/logs, /v1/traces and /v1/metrics; OTLP/gRPC takes protobuf.

namespace_binding.description: Which Fabric namespace the signals land in. The namespaced path already carries it; this is for the plain :4318/:4317 loopback listener a collector that cannot set paths uses, which is bound to exactly one namespace (CN1 Task 13).

topic_prefix.description: The topic prefix the per-signal topics take, as <prefix>.logs, <prefix>.traces, <prefix>.metrics; the manifest's envelope.emits names the log type io.loams.dev.flow.opentelemetry.log.v1, and the span and metric alternates are .span.v1 and .metric.v1 (CN1 Ruling 2).

partial_success.description: Answer a request with OTLP's partial_success and the rejected records' count instead of failing the whole request (CN1 Task 13's otlp_partial_success).

search_logs.description: Also forward OTLP logs that are meant for search to the engine's §02 §7.1 endpoint (CN1 Task 13).

resource_attributes.description: Resource attributes added to every event this instance emits, as attribute name to value; they are names, not secrets, so nothing here is writeOnly.

body_limit_bytes.description: The largest OTLP request body accepted.

auth.description: How a request authenticates; the manifest's auth slugs key and mtls (§33 Appendix A.13).

bearer_token.description: An Authorization: Bearer token. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

tls.description: TLS material for the `mtls` auth slug on the gRPC listener.

key_pem.description: The server certificate's private key for the listener, or the collector's client key. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

verify_full.description: Whether the client certificate's identity is verified.
